Password save and fill fixture

Loopback only, synthetic values only. Fields have no names, so no typed value is ever sent to this server.

  • A form that navigates after Sign In
  • A form that signs in with a request and stays on the page
  • A same-origin frame and a cross-origin frame
  • A page that patches the built-ins the listener uses
  • The same form on localhost, so another origin and another site
